new_this_week.title: I Will Find You
new_this_week.about: A father (Sam Worthington) wrongfully imprisoned for his son's murder learns the boy may be alive, and breaks out to find the truth. Britt Lower plays his investigative-journalist sister-in-law; Milo Ventimiglia, Logan Browning, Chi McBride co-star. Showrunner Robert Hull adapts Coben's 2023 bestseller.
